exposure: Neonates who experienced bonding vs. those who were separated
cohort: 31 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 and their neonates
finding: Maternal bonding, including rooming-in, skin-to-skin contact, and breastfeeding, appears to be safe in neonates born to mothers who are SARS-CoV-2 positive, as no neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infections were observed.
